# Components: Feedback and status

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from Generated/*.razor, blazor/mappings, generated.manifest.json and core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every component renders its element with the parameters you set as attributes. An attribute that is not a parameter (`id`, `class`, `data-*`, `aria-*`, ...) is put on the element as it is, and a `class` is added to the component's own (`ExtraClass` on a component that lists it). Names are `Pk` plus the tag in PascalCase.

## `PkAlert`

`<pk-alert>`: **Alert** (Feedback & status). A persistent message in a kind (info, success, warning, danger): optional heading, actions, a dismiss button, a full-bleed banner variant for the top of a page, and a plain form (coloured text only, optionally inline and compact).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Kind` | `PkAlertKind` | `Error` `Warning` `Info` `Success` | attribute `kind` | The kind setting |
| `Title` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | The heading setting |
| `Message` | `string?` |  | default slot | Message. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | Message. |
| `Dismissible` | `bool` |  | attribute `dismissible` | The dismissible setting |
| `OnDismiss` | `EventCallback` |  | event `pk-dismiss` | Dismissed; cancelable. |
| `Boxed` | `bool` |  | attribute `plain` | Coloured text with no box, icon or panel: the quiet form for a message beside a field or under a button. False is the plain form (coloured text, no box); the parameter is the opposite of the plain prop. |
| `Inline` | `bool` |  | attribute `inline` | Flows in a line of text (like a span) instead of a block; use with plain. |
| `Compact` | `bool` |  | attribute `compact` | Smaller text and no margin, for an actions strip. |
| `ExtraClass` | `string?` |  |  | Extra CSS classes for the element. |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-alert` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.

## `PkEmptyState`

`<pk-empty-state>`: **Empty state** (Feedback). What a list shows when it has no rows: an optional icon, a title, a description and the actions that fill it. Densities for a whole page, a panel or a table row.

Hand-written component (not generated).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | The title, as text (the element's `heading`). |
| `Description` | `string?` |  | attribute `description` | The description, as text. |
| `Tone` | `string?` |  | attribute `tone` | The density: `default`, `compact`, `boxed` or `error`. Left off, the element's own default applies. |
| `TitleContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `heading` | A title with markup; it fills the heading slot. |
| `DescriptionContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | A description with markup; it is the body of the element. |
| `IconContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `icon` | An icon above the title. |
| `ActionContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `actions` | The actions that fill the empty state (a button to add the first row). |

Element details (parts, CSS custom properties, methods, accessibility): `pk-empty-state` in the `plainkit-sdk` skill.

## `PkToast`

`<pk-toast>`: **Toast** (Feedback & status). One transient message: kind, optional title, message, an action slot and a dismiss button; pauses its timer on hover and focus.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Enum values | Sets | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Kind` | `ToastKind` | `Info` `Success` `Warning` `Danger` | attribute `kind` | The kind setting |
| `Heading` | `string?` |  | attribute `heading` | The heading setting |
| `Message` | `string?` |  | attribute `message` | Used when nothing is slotted. |
| `Duration` | `int` |  | attribute `duration` | Milliseconds before it dismisses itself; 0 keeps it until dismissed; -1 is automatic (5s, 8s with an action). |
| `NoClose` | `bool` |  | attribute `no-close` | Hide the dismiss button. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | default slot | Message. |
| `ActionContent` | `RenderFragment?` |  | slot `action` | One or two buttons. |
| `OnDismiss` | `EventCallback<PkDismissEventArgs>` |  | event `pk-dismiss` | timeout, close, action or method. |

When you set a named fragment (`ActionContent`), write the body as an explicit `<ChildContent>` tag too: Razor does not allow an implicit body next to a named fragment.

**Event args**

| Event | Args class | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `pk-dismiss` | `PkDismissEventArgs` | Reason: string? |
